=====================================================================
NEXUS MOD PAGE  -  copy/paste into the Description box (BBCode)
Mod name:  Extra Game Speeds (4x / 6x / 8x)
Category:  Gameplay  |  Version: 1.0.0
=====================================================================

[size=4][b]What it does[/b][/size]

Adds [b]4x, 6x and 8x[/b] speed buttons right next to the vanilla 1x / 2x / 3x.

Your chosen speed [b]carries over to the next wave[/b], the same way the vanilla
speeds do. Pause and menus keep working normally.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[b]BepInEx 6 for IL2CPP, build 755 or newer.[/b]
Older builds will not work: 9 Kings runs on Unity 6, and only BepInEx BE #755+
can read its IL2CPP metadata.

Easiest option: install [url=https://thunderstore.io/c/9-kings/p/BepInEx/BepInExPack_IL2CPP/]BepInExPack IL2CPP[/url] from Thunderstore,
or use a mod manager such as r2modman or Gale, which installs it for you.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install BepInEx first, then [b]launch the game once and let it sit for a few minutes[/b].
The first launch is slow because BepInEx is generating files it needs.
[*]Extract this mod's [i]BepInEx[/i] folder into your game folder, so the file ends up at:
[code]<game>\BepInEx\plugins\NineKings.UltraSpeed\NineKings.UltraSpeed.dll[/code]
[*]Launch the game.
[/list]

Steam game folder: [code]...\Steam\steamapps\common\9 Kings[/code]

[size=4][b]How to use[/b][/size]

Start a battle. Three new buttons appear to the right of 3x:

[list]
[*][b]yellow[/b] = 4x
[*][b]orange[/b] = 6x
[*][b]red[/b] = 8x
[/list]

Click one, or press [b]4[/b] / [b]5[/b] / [b]6[/b].
Click the same button again to drop back to 3x. Picking 1x / 2x / 3x also turns it off.

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

Created on first run at:
[code]<game>\BepInEx\config\com.mods.ninekings.ultraspeed.cfg[/code]

[list]
[*][b]Speeds[/b] - [i]4,6,8[/i] - one button per value. Add more if you want, e.g. [i]4,6,8,12[/i]
[*][b]Hotkeys[/b] - [i]Digit4,Digit5,Digit6[/i] - same order as Speeds
[*][b]IconTints[/b] - [i]#FFD24A,#FF8A3D,#FF3D3D[/i] - button colours, same order
[*][b]IncludeInCycle[/b] - [i]true[/i] - include them when cycling speed
[*][b]Persist[/b] - [i]true[/i] - keep your speed between waves
[/list]

[size=4][b]Uninstall[/b][/size]

Delete [code]<game>\BepInEx\plugins\NineKings.UltraSpeed\[/code]
No game files are modified.

[size=4][b]Bugs[/b][/size]

If something breaks, please post it here. Say what happened and, if you can,
attach [code]<game>\BepInEx\LogOutput.log[/code]


---------------------------------------------------------------------
BLOQUE VORTEX  -  pegar justo despues de la seccion "Installation"
Sustituye <EXTENSION_URL> por el enlace de tu extension una vez publicada.
---------------------------------------------------------------------

[size=4][b]Installing with Vortex[/b][/size]

Vortex has no built-in support for 9 Kings, so it needs a small game extension first.

[list=1]
[*]Download the [url=<EXTENSION_URL>]9 Kings Vortex Extension[/url] and drop the archive
onto Vortex's [i]Extensions[/i] page (Settings -> Extensions -> drag & drop), then restart Vortex.
[*]Go to [i]Games[/i], find [b]9 Kings[/b] under Unmanaged and click [b]Manage[/b].
[*]Install [url=https://thunderstore.io/c/9-kings/p/BepInEx/BepInExPack_IL2CPP/]BepInExPack IL2CPP[/url]
into the game folder yourself, then [b]launch the game once and let it finish[/b].
The first launch is slow because BepInEx is generating files it needs.
[*]Download this mod's archive with [b]Manual download[/b], then drag it into Vortex's
drop zone (or use [i]Mods -> Install From File[/i]).
[*]Click [b]Install[/b], then [b]Deploy[/b].
[/list]

[b]Why BepInEx is not installed automatically:[/b] 9 Kings runs on Unity 6 with IL2CPP
(metadata v39). Only BepInEx 6 bleeding edge build [b]755 or newer[/b] can read it, and
Vortex's generic BepInEx installer serves older builds that break the game. The extension
deliberately leaves that step to you and just points you at the right build.

[b]Note:[/b] the green "Mod Manager Download" button does not appear for 9 Kings, because
Nexus has not enabled Vortex for this game's page. Use "Manual download" and drop the file
into Vortex - it works exactly the same from there on.
